metadata.modifications: Removed plotting, close/clc and per-iteration logging; instrumented maximum-iteration exits; printed 12 significant digits. Case 3 records all timesteps rather than only those after 5 s. No physics, loading, solver tolerances, or time steps were changed.
metadata.sampling: Probe is zero-based node 19 (the 20th of 40). Its y-coordinate is recorded at every time step. All 40 node coordinates are saved at step 1, each 1 s, every step from 6.9 to 7.1 s for buckling, and every 0.1 s from 14 to 16.5 s for snap-through (within each captured interval).
metadata.original_solver: Newton tolerance 1e-4 and maximum_iter 10 (the source can return on the 11th iteration); browser solver uses a 1e-7 residual tolerance and a line search.
